w: 13 Dec. 99 to 16 Dec. 99 Maha Abhishek Ceremony of Murtis at Swaminarayan Mandir, Tithal, and 79th Birthday Celebration Festival at Valsad.
December 99: (Kartak Vad 9, V.S. 2056), Wednesday, Kailashpuri

After performing the murti pratishtha ceremony at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Swamishri addressed the devotees in a huge assembly: "… Many intelligent people say that where is the need for mandirs? Why don't you build schools, colleges and hospitals. The answer is we do build schools, colleges and hospitals and perform various social services. Yes, we do need to stay with society and the country (and offer our services to it) but alongwith this it is also important that people should be inspired with moral and spiritual values. And if there is no character then there will be conflict and unrest between man and man. If we want to bring Satyuga in Kaliyuga then one has to abide by God's laws. Through Satsang one is inspired with moral and spiritual values and with peace in life… Through such holy places our society will improve and get better…"
We have been blessed with the infinite favors of God and for that when we build a mandir it benefits our society, our country, and redeems our soul.
Dharma bestows goodness and happiness in life.
It is because of our dehbhav (profound attachment to physical self) that we cannot establish Satsang as it is in our soul.

The world is not still and unwavering and one's mind is also not still and unwavering. Then how can one attain peace and happiness by merely talking about it? it is God who gives stillness to the world and mind.
This morning, Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha for the murtis of the mandir at Bhandut. This was the 400th murti pratishtha ceremony performed by Swamishri.
The evening assembly was celebrated as 'Bal Din' in which the commitment and sacrifice of Bal Karyakars was justly appreciated.

ph: Swamishri with sadhus while having breakfast

w: In the evening satsang assembly, BAPS youths performed a traditional dance. The BAPS Youth Forum enacted a drama, 'Kaf', which showed the pride of devotees who have internalized satsang in their lives. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the assembly, "Be he a sadhu or a householder, if one is proud of satsang then the devotee experiences happiness and pride in his life. When one realizes the glory of God's form then one loses all love for worldly things. He performs his worldly duties but God and His realized Sadhu are primary in his life ..."

A devotee came for Swamishri’s darshan. Formerly he was doing a lot of satsang and came regularly to the mandir. But due to bad company he got hooked to drinking liquor and thus stopped doing satsang. Swamishri asked him, “Why are you not coming here?” “A lot of my time goes into doing business. There’s no time left for satsang,” the devotee offered an excuse. Swamishri countered, “So many in the world run businesses an still attend satsang regularly. If they can take time out then why can’t you? When your relatives arrive don’t you have to take time out for them? Similarly, you have to do it for God. Come once in a day for darshan to the mandir. Make all efforts to earn, but you also have to do something for your soul.” “He has become habituated to drinking liquor,” someone revealed. “Yes, that’s why you have stopped coming to the mandir. Instead of stopping to come to the mandir, you should stop drinking!” Swamishri inspired him with care and love to do satsang.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
